name: Aaple Sarkar / MahaOnline Citizen Services
description: Maharashtra's integrated online portal (Aaple Sarkar / MahaOnline) for certificates, schemes, and citizen services.
benefits: Single window for caste/income/residence certificates, scheme applications, grievance redressal.
fees: As per state fee schedule per service.
office_locator_info: SETU / CSC centres across Maharashtra districts.

faq.q: What certificates can I get here?
faq.a: Caste, income, residence, birth/death, and many scheme applications.

ai_summary: Aaple Sarkar (MahaOnline) is Maharashtra's single-window portal for certificates and schemes.
ai_explanation: Maharashtra's Aaple Sarkar / MahaOnline portal lets residents apply for caste, income, residence, and other certificates plus state schemes from one place, with online tracking and SETU centre support. It is the gateway to most Maharashtra e-services.
